Q: Command line help message with the glib GApplication API A:

GApplication doesn't expose a public API to retrieve the help string directly — this is a known gap. The clean workaround is to temporarily spawn your app with --help as a subprocess and capture stdout, or fall back to maintaining a parallel GOptionContext solely for help generation. The separation of GApplication from GtkApplication was architectural, not a signal that full CLI parity was intended.

Q: How can I insert multiple rows in SQLite? A:

You can use InsertHelper. It is easy and fast.

Tutorial: Android: Using DatabaseUtils.InsertHelper for faster insertions into SQLite database

InsertHelper is deprecated as of API Level 17 (Android 4.1 (Jelly Bean. 2012 vintage)).

Q: Local module descriptor class for com.google.android.gms.providerinstaller.dynamite not found. Flutter Firebase A:

Check for updates for Google Play Services and Google Repository and install any updates available.

Inside app/build.gradle

implementation 'com.google.android.gms:play-services-base:18.1.0'
implementation 'com.google.firebase:firebase-database:20.1.0'

Clear Cache and Rebuild Project by Flutter clean and flutter run

Also check google-services.json File

Q: How to write a file path that will point to a directory? A:

Looks like you need to hope out one more parent directory, to the root test1.framer directory, before you can go into the imported directory. ie:

myLayers= Framer.Importer.load("../../imported/test1")

(starting from main.js file and only going up one parent directory only gets you in the app directory)

Q: How to save .txt as Unicode or UTF-8 in VBA A:

Hope this might save someone some time:

Sub ExportToTxt()
    Dim fileStream As Object
    Set fileStream = CreateObject("ADODB.Stream")
    fileStream.Charset = "utf-8"
    fileStream.Open

    Dim rangeToExport As Range
    Set rangeToExport = Worksheets("BPC-Processed").Range("A1").CurrentRegion

    Dim firstCol, lastCol, firstRow, lastRow As Integer
    firstCol = rangeToExport.Columns(1).Column
    lastCol = firstCol + rangeToExport.Columns.Count - 1
    firstRow = rangeToExport.Rows(1).row
    lastRow = firstRow + rangeToExport.Rows.Count - 1

    Dim r, c As Integer
    Dim str As String
    Dim delimiter As String
    For r = firstRow To lastRow
        str = ""
        For c = firstCol To lastCol
            If c = 1 Then
                delimiter = ""
            Else
                delimiter = vbTab ' tab
            End If
            str = str & delimiter & rangeToExport.Cells(r, c).Value
        Next c
        fileStream.WriteText str & vbCrLf ' vbCrLf: linebreak
    Next r

    Dim filePath As String
    filePath = Application.ThisWorkbook.Path & "\BPC-Processed.txt"
    fileStream.SaveToFile filePath, 2 ' 2: Create Or Update
    fileStream.Close
End Sub
